## REQ-RES-REFDES-001

**Fields of the ReferenceDesignation DataSet**

The Payload of a ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage contains the optional objects Function, Product and Location (reference designation of the asset according to IEC 81346-1); each object contains the mandatory String Value (designation value), the optional String Local (local designation value) and the optional object Parent, which contains the mandatory String Value, the optional String Local and the optional String IdentificationLink (unencoded Identification Link of the parent asset); no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (REQ-CMP-020).
- Scope: MG 4
- Refs: MG 8.3.10, SF-068
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-019bdfbb, MG-8.3.10-22c4a47c, MG-8.3.10-26a4343a, MG-8.3.10-2f17eff0, MG-8.3.10-39f50e4b, MG-8.3.10-3bbf3213, MG-8.3.10-4a1eeb66, MG-8.3.10-58beecf9, MG-8.3.10-6fbcf97c, MG-8.3.10-7929f9e5, MG-8.3.10-8193fbf4, MG-8.3.10-8851752a, MG-8.3.10-9b0d0262, MG-8.3.10-9d8f0779, MG-8.3.10-afcbf2a0, MG-8.3.10-b4413780, MG-8.3.10-cd52e787, MG-8.3.10-d84c70c5, MG-8.3.10-e56a9465, MG-8.3.10-ebee4426, MG-8.3.10-fefc7b1d

Notes: The structure is identical for all three objects (SF-068 (d), GL-ADR-019).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-002

**ReferenceDesignation is persisted**

A component that accepts the ReferenceDesignation from outside persists it (application specific), so that it survives a restart.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for ReferenceDesignation.
- Refs: MG 8.3.10
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-f5ceed18

> Therefore, it must be persisted on an application-specific basis.
> — MG 8.3.10

## REQ-RES-REFDES-003

**Get ReferenceDesignation carries no ReferenceDesignation object**

A Get ReferenceDesignation NetworkMessage contains no ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale and – only without Source – Query.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12, MG 8.3.13
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-062, SF-069, SF-073
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-d0686981

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage.
> — MG 9.1.10

> The NetworkMessage can alternatively contain DataSetMessages for PaginationRequest (8.3.11.1 PaginationRequest) and Locale (8.3.12 Locale) and, without Source, a DataSetMessage for Query (8.3.13.1 Query of ReferenceDesignation).
> — MG 9.1.10

> A ReferenceDesignation object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Query added by GL-ADR-020 (SF-069, SF-073, C-027 review); its placement rules are REQ-QRY-001 and REQ-RES-REFDES-013.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-004

**Get ReferenceDesignation is answered with all addressed objects**

A Get ReferenceDesignation is answered with the ReferenceDesignation of every asset addressed by the topic – without Source all assets of the component, with Source only that asset – each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to the corresponding Pub topic.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (REQ-CMP-020).
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-963a219d, MG-9.1.10-a4676341

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>] combination Get/ReferenceDesignation[/&lt;Source>], the publication of this information to the Pub/ReferenceDesignation[/&lt;Source>] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.10

> A topic, such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/ReferenceDesignation, must trigger a publication of all available ReferenceDesignation information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/ReferenceDesignation.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-005

**Pub ReferenceDesignation carries objects and optionally Pagination**

A Pub ReferenceDesignation NetworkMessage contains ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-060b0841

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type ReferenceDesignation – none in the answer to a Get without content (Resources Without Content) – and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: A Locale is only meaningful in a Get and ignored in other methods (REQ-LOC-003).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-006

**Set ReferenceDesignation addresses exactly one asset**

A Set ReferenceDesignation is sent to Set/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> and its NetworkMessage contains exactly one ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage – the object of the asset addressed by the topic, which replaces its complete ReferenceDesignation (aspects not contained are removed).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, MG 8.3.10, SF-068
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-c4dc0834, MG-9.1.10-90a987bb, MG-9.1.10-c7b9efea, MG-9.1.10-e3d3cf86

> A topic with method Set must contain Resource and Source to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.10

> The ReferenceDesignation object of an asset is always handled as a whole: a Set replaces the complete object, i.e. aspects (Function, Product, Location) which are not contained in the Set are removed, and a Del deletes the complete ReferenceDesignation of the asset (9.1.10 ReferenceDesignation).
> — MG 8.3.10

> Each publication, using the method Set must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.10

> Setting multiple reference designations at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Set/ReferenceDesignation is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Whole-object semantics per SF-068 (f), GL-ADR-019; topic form per REQ-TOP-013 (matrix).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-007

**Del ReferenceDesignation addresses exactly one asset**

A Del ReferenceDesignation is sent to Del/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> and its NetworkMessage contains no ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage; it deletes the complete ReferenceDesignation of the asset identified by the Source.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-068
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-b6c074a3, MG-9.1.10-dfcc5dea, MG-9.1.10-f55cfe37

> In combination with the method Del, a ReferenceDesignation object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.10

> A topic with method Del must contain Resource and Source to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.10

> Each publication, using the method Del must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.10

> Deleting multiple reference designations at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Del/ReferenceDesignation is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Whole-object semantics per MG 8.3.10 (REQ-RES-REFDES-006), SF-068 (e), GL-ADR-019.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-008

**Set and Del ReferenceDesignation are protected by ACL**

The operator of the Message Bus prevents Set and Del ReferenceDesignation by unauthorized communication participants via the ACL of the broker.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 9.1.10
- Verification: d8
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-0787e338, MG-9.1.10-65150700

> To prevent write access by unauthorized communication participants, the operator must prevent this via ACL.
> — MG 9.1.10

## REQ-RES-REFDES-009

**Status event after Set and Del ReferenceDesignation**

After a Set or Del ReferenceDesignation, the component publishes an Event of the category Status about the command on Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;StatusCode> with the Source of the request topic – mandatory from Level 2 on, recommended at Level 1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set or Del for ReferenceDesignation.
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-067
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-10ba461f, MG-9.1.10-b249d192

> After a Set message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Set command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;StatusCode> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller.
> — MG 9.1.10

> After a Del message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Del command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;StatusCode> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Same obligation as REQ-TOP-014/015; the last topic level is the EventLevel (SF-067 (g), GL-ADR-019). Event content: RES-EVENT (C-028).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-010

**Changed ReferenceDesignation is published after a successful Set**

After a successful Set ReferenceDesignation, the component publishes the new ReferenceDesignation of the asset to Pub/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> with the ReplyTo of the Set.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for ReferenceDesignation and the Set was successful.
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-068
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-51f2cf7c

> If setting ReferenceDesignation was successful, the new ReferenceDesignation must be published to the Pub/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> topic, according to the settings in PublicationList (8.3.8 PublicationList).
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Topic per SF-068 (b), GL-ADR-019; ReplyTo per REQ-MSG-015.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-011

**Support of the Query of ReferenceDesignation**

A component that supports the resource ReferenceDesignation supports the request of the children of an asset via the Query of ReferenceDesignation – optional at Level 1 and 2, mandatory at Level 3.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MAY · L2 MAY · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (REQ-CMP-020).
- Refs: MG 1.3, MG 8.3.13.1, GL-ADR-020, SF-069, SF-073
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-fc5dfccb, MG-8.3.13.1-18dcbb80

> A component that supports the resource ReferenceDesignation may support the request of the children of an asset via Query at Level 1 and 2 and must support it at Level 3 (8.3.13.1 Query of ReferenceDesignation).
> — MG 1.3

> The support of the Query of ReferenceDesignation is optional at compliance Level 1 and 2 and mandatory at Level 3 for every component that supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (1.3 Compliance Domains and Levels).
> — MG 8.3.13.1

Notes: PO decision in the C-027 review (2026-10-20): option (b) "OneDown" of SF-069, optional at L1/L2, mandatory at L3; carrier: generic Query (SF-073). REQ-CMP-020 makes the resource itself L2 SHOULD, L3 MUST.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-012

**Query parameters of ReferenceDesignation**

The Payload of a Query DataSetMessage on Get/ReferenceDesignation contains the query parameters: the mandatory String Parent (unencoded Identification Link of the asset whose children are requested) and the optional String Aspect with one of the values "Function", "Product" or "Location"; no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Condition: The Get/ReferenceDesignation carries a Query.
- Scope: MG 4
- Refs: MG 8.3.13.1, GL-ADR-020
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13.1-33176e50, MG-8.3.13.1-417aaa0a

Notes: Reserved DataSetWriterId 9, WriterGroupName "Query", DataSetWriterName = requester (REQ-MSG-019). A receiver ignores undefined query parameters (REQ-QRY-002).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-013

**Query of ReferenceDesignation only without Source**

A Query is only sent on Get/ReferenceDesignation without Source; a receiver ignores a Query on Get/ReferenceDesignation with Source.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester, responder
- Condition: The Get/ReferenceDesignation carries a Query.
- Scope: MG 8.3.13
- Refs: MG 8.3.13.1, GL-ADR-020, SF-035
- Verification: d7-validate, d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13.1-3feaca7a

> The Query of ReferenceDesignation is only meaningful in combination with the topic …/Get/ReferenceDesignation without Source; with Source it is ignored by the receiver.
> — MG 8.3.13.1

Notes: The generic placement (method Get, at most once) is REQ-QRY-001. A receiver tolerates the misplaced helper (REQ-MSG-046); the strict checker flags it at the sender (REQ-MSG-001). Reclassified in C-041 (-schema, consistency review of the P2 exit, ADR-0019 §9): a Query only without Source depends on the topic (R-2); the entry schema covers the topic form with and without Source and does not report this requirement.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-014

**A Query of ReferenceDesignation is answered with the direct children**

A component that supports the Query of ReferenceDesignation answers a Get/ReferenceDesignation with Query with the ReferenceDesignation objects of exactly those assets it provides ReferenceDesignation information for, whose Parent of the requested Aspect – without Aspect: of at least one aspect – has an IdentificationLink equal to the requested Parent (comparison per MG 4.1). Only direct children are included. The answer is published like the answer to a Get without Source: each object in its own DataSetMessage on Pub/ReferenceDesignation with the MessageId of the Get as ReplyTo, paginated if necessary; if no asset matches, Messages is empty.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component supports the Query of ReferenceDesignation (REQ-RES-REFDES-011).
- Scope: MG 4.1, MG 8.3.11
- Refs: MG 8.3.13.1, MG 9.1.10, GL-ADR-020
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13.1-14367aab, MG-8.3.13.1-2856ce44, MG-8.3.13.1-bd151745, MG-9.1.10-912abe06

> An application that supports the Query of ReferenceDesignation must answer such a Get with the ReferenceDesignation objects of exactly those assets it provides ReferenceDesignation information for, whose Parent of the requested Aspect contains an IdentificationLink equal to the requested Parent (4.1 IEC 61406-1 Identification Link).
> — MG 8.3.13.1

> Without Aspect, an object matches if the Parent of at least one of its aspects matches.
> — MG 8.3.13.1

> The answer is published like the answer to a Get without Source (9.1.10 ReferenceDesignation): each object in its own DataSetMessage, published to the topic …/Pub/ReferenceDesignation, with the MessageId of the Get as ReplyTo and paginated if necessary (8.3.11 Pagination).
> — MG 8.3.13.1

> If no asset matches, the answer contains no ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage ("Messages": []).
> — MG 8.3.13.1

> Only the direct children are requested.
> — MG 8.3.13.1

> The application answers with the matching objects as described in 8.3.13.1 Query of ReferenceDesignation, published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/ReferenceDesignation.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Children represented by other applications are requested from those applications (informative note of MG 8.3.13.1). Pagination: REQ-PAG-005; ReplyTo: REQ-MSG-015.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-015

**Requester checks the Parent of the answer**

A requester of a Query of ReferenceDesignation checks the Parent of the received ReferenceDesignation objects, because a component without support for it ignores the Query and answers with all objects.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Condition: The requester sent a Query of ReferenceDesignation.
- Refs: MG 8.3.13.1, GL-ADR-020
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13.1-2c0f88d0

> An application that does not support it ignores the Query and answers with all ReferenceDesignation objects; therefore, a requester should check the Parent of the received objects.
> — MG 8.3.13.1

## REQ-RES-REFDES-016

**IdentificationLink of the Parent is provided**

The Parent of an aspect of a ReferenceDesignation contains the IdentificationLink of the parent asset whenever the parent asset has an Identification Link.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (REQ-CMP-020).
- Refs: MG 8.3.10, GL-ADR-020
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-d8256e38

> Therefore, the IdentificationLink of a Parent should be provided whenever the parent asset has an Identification Link.
> — MG 8.3.10

Notes: The Query of ReferenceDesignation finds children only by Parent.IdentificationLink (REQ-RES-REFDES-014).
